english.note: Use this when the focus is physical stability or an object being unlikely to tip over rather than nutritional or proportional balance.
This is the all-purpose choice for something that is physically properly balanced or in equilibrium.

examples.english: The vase has a wide base, so it stays balanced.
examples.traditional: 個花樽個底夠闊，擺得好平衡。
examples.jyutping: go3 faa1 zeon1 go3 dai2 gau3 fut3 baai2 dak1 hou2 ping4 hang4

examples.english: The two sides of this scale weigh the same, so it is really well-balanced.
examples.traditional: 呢個天秤兩邊重量一樣，真係平衡。
